---
title: "Computational Mineralogy Laboratory"
---

This website contains the instructions and supporting material for the
computational laboratory activities of the Mineral Science course.

During the laboratory you will work in your own GitHub Codespaces environment.

- **This website** contains instructions, assignments and reference material.
- **Your personal workspace repository** contains notebooks, data and your own work.
- **CluMiner** is used separately when CRYSTAL calculations are required.

## Laboratory path

1. Crystal structures, CIF files and symmetry
2. First-principles energy and geometry optimization
3. Energy-volume data and equations of state
4. Vibrations, phonons and thermodynamic properties

Short questions are answered directly inside the laboratory notebooks.
